newsitem.title: DOMINICAN REPUBLIC: One dead as Dominican Republic strike ends.
newsitem.headline: One dead as Dominican Republic strike ends.

text.p: One man died and a police officer was wounded on Wednesday in a second day of clashes in the southern town of San Juan de la Maguana during a national strike, police and radio reports said.
Asthma sufferer Jose Cabrera, 62, died after inhaling tear gas fired by police at demonstrators backing the strike called to protest high prices and unemployment, local radio said.
Police said officer Juan de los Santos was wounded by a shotgun blast and accused protestors of shooting him.

The two-day-old strike, called by labour unions and popular organisations to demand a lower cost of living and more jobs, ended later on Wednesday after the government said it would start talks with the organisers.
At least five people were injured in similar clashes on Tuesday in San Juan de la Maguana and outlying districts of the capital Santo Domingo.
